title: Roadmap — fatias verticais (ágil)
summary: Milestone roadmap (M0–M7, MVP concluído) and a data-driven, cost-vs-value prioritized backlog for the Foto Organizer app's next versions.
notes: Structured as a prioritized backlog/roadmap with per-milestone 'Aceite' (acceptance criteria) and per-item cost/value/dependency rationale, which overlaps with PRD-style requirement framing. Classified as DOC because its primary function is planning narrative and prioritization rationale referencing locked decisions (D-024..D-035) in docs/DECISOES.md rather than itself defining new user-facing requirements or contracts; no frontmatter, no ADR Decision/Consequences structure, no API/schema content.
